title: Enamel matrix derivative in liquid form as adjunct to natural bovine bone grafting at buccal bone dehiscence defects at implant sites: An experimental study in beagle dogs
authors: Ikawa T, Akizu ki T, Shujaa Addin A, Fukuba S, Stavropoulos A, Izumi Y. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2019 Oct;30(10):989-996. doi: 10.1111/clr.13512.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “cerabone® enhances bone regeneration and osseointegration at implants with buccal bone dehiscences compared with no grafting, and adjunct use of EMD -liquid appears to further enhance bone formation and osseointegration” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
